rows.grounds: numeral indicating the eight supernatural powers
compound with internal sandhi: siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ + mūlakaulam

items.question: What constitutes the root Kaula attainment alongside the eight supernatural powers?
premises: The eight supernatural powers are included among the attainments.
The attainment of these powers is identified as the root Kaula.
items.inference: Therefore, the attainment of the eight supernatural powers belongs to the essential realization of the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The precise scope of 'mūlakaulaṃ' in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight supernatural powers is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
